name: Flush the DNS cache
summary: Clears the endpoint's local DNS resolver cache so stale or poisoned answers are looked up again.
risk_note: Names are resolved afresh, so the next few lookups are a little slower. No configuration changes.

windows: Runs ipconfig /flushdns, clearing the DNS Client service's cache.
linux: Flushes systemd-resolved's cache (resolvectl flush-caches) where it is running.
Invalidates nscd's hosts cache where nscd is running, and sends dnsmasq the signal that clears its cache where it is running.
Reports that there is nothing to flush when none of these runs: most Linux systems without them do not cache DNS locally.
darwin: Runs dscacheutil -flushcache and signals mDNSResponder to drop its cache.
